title: 28% With No Religion Now Outnumber Catholics
hook: No religion now claims 28% of Americans, passing Catholics.
closing: The country's religious map is changing with each generation.
question: Do you consider yourself religious?

segments.say: In 1990, 8% of US adults had no religion; that share has more than tripled.
Among millennials, 36% have no religion, more than triple the oldest generation.
Today 28% say none, passing Catholics while Protestants remain ahead.
